transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Well, what brought me in is... my head just feels so foggy lately. I keep mixing up simple things. Like appointment times, dates for the exhibits I help out with, or even which volunteer I already called. It's just... frustrating.
How long have you been experiencing these lapses in memory and focus?
Well, I'd say it's been going on for about four months now. It seemed to start right around the time we had some water damage... which pushed us into doing a remodel.
During these past four months, have you felt persistently sad, hopeless, or lost interest in the activities you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. It's... well, things I used to love just sit there now. My watercolors, the tomato plants I usually fuss over... I even stopped going to line dancing. I used to really enjoy watching the cardinals out in the back yard, too, but lately I just can't seem to make myself care about any of it.
Have you ever experienced a period like this in the past, where you felt this same persistent sadness or lack of interest?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I felt down for a day or two, but nothing like this. This is... it's just been going on for months, and I've never had anything last this long before.
Have you noticed if you are moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, or conversely, that you feel so restless that you cannot sit still?

Well, I definitely haven't felt restless. It's more the slowing down. My husband says I move like I'm wading through mud now. It just... it takes me a really long time to do simple things, like even getting up to answer the phone or sort the mail. I just feel very slow.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your weight since you started feeling this way?

Yes, I have noticed a change. I just don't have much of an appetite anymore. Most days I just pick at a piece of toast or maybe have a little soup because food just doesn't sound good to me. And I've definitely lost some weight. I haven't been trying to, but I've noticed that my skirts have gotten quite loose on me lately.
Are you able to manage your daily self-care tasks, such as bathing, dressing, or brushing your teeth, or have you stopped doing those things entirely?

I'm still doing them, mostly. I haven't stopped entirely, no. It's just... it's a lot harder now. Taking a shower just feels like such a big chore, so I might skip a day here and there, which I never used to do. But I do still get dressed and brush my teeth. It just takes me longer to get it all done.
Have you been experiencing any unusual thoughts, such as feeling like you are being watched or sensing things that others do not seem to see?

No, nothing like that. I haven't felt like anyone is watching me, and I haven't seen or heard anything unusual. It's just... mostly the tiredness and the slowing down, like I mentioned. But no strange thoughts or anything.
